assistworld-assist-world:lever:3c30795d-.description: About the Role We are a high-growth psychiatric practice that is expanding to 15 states via telemedicine, alongside a specialized physical clinic in Fairfax, VA (focused on TMS and Ketamine). We have moved away from traditional agency models to a high-efficiency AI-Augmented Stack. We are looking for an Operations Manager to "pilot" this machine. You are not responsible for manual content writing or manual keyword bidding; you are responsible for orchestrating tools and ensuring clinical ROI.
responsibilities: AI Content Orchestration: Use HubSpot Breeze to generate localized landing pages for 15 states and clinical blogs. You will audit these for medical accuracy (E-E-A-T) and brand voice.
Productized Service Oversight: Monitor  Ranked.ai  deliverables. Audit their weekly PPC reports to ensure our Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) remains healthy and negative keywords are being filtered.
Reputation & GEO-SEO: Manage KiwiHealth to respond to patient reviews (HIPAA-compliant) and ensure our "Virtual Proximity" listings are accurate across 15 states.
Closed-Loop Reporting: Maintain a HubSpot Enterprise dashboard that tracks the journey from "Ad Click" to "Booked Appointment" to "5-Star Review."
qualifications: HubSpot Enterprise Proficiency: You must understand Workflows, Custom Objects, and the Breeze AI Content Agent.
AI-Native Workflow: You prefer using AI and productized services over manual labor.
Healthcare Experience (Preferred): Understanding of HIPAA compliance and medical search intent (TMS, Ketamine, Psychiatry).
Data-Driven: You focus on CPA and Conversion Rates, not "vanity metrics" like clicks or impressions.

beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:5a.title: Product Manager
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:5a.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be joining Beacon's Portfolio Product team, a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists. We work directly with our 30+ portfolio companies, businesses we're acquiring at roughly one per week, to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software. As a Product Manager, you'll own product outcomes for 3-4 portfolio companies at a time. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figuring out where the leverage is and shipping software directly into their business. The best PMs in this role won't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at. They'll compress what they learned into reusable playbooks that ship to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. Key Responsibilities - Own product outcomes for 3-4 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional product leader embedded in each business - Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals - Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints - Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time - Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions - Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions - Coordinate feature launches across engineering, sales, marketing, and support - Coach developers, designers, and early PMs to think like product managers - Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies What We're Looking For - BA/BS Degree - 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS - Strong fundamentals: roadmapping, sprint planning, spec writing, prioritization frameworks - Sharp customer discovery instincts and ability to identify high-impact opportunities fast - Comfortable managing multiple companies and stakeholders simultaneously - Ability to influence founders and executives without direct authority - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity This role is perfect for you if... - You are an ex-founder or want to start your own B2B SaaS company one day - You want real exposure to how profitable businesses are built and scaled across multiple industries - You get more satisfaction from building capability in others than shipping features yoursel

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:17.title: Estimator - HVAC
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:17.description: The Estimator is accountable for the accuracy, completeness, defensibility, and profitability of all commercial plumbing estimates produced by the organization. This role functions as a core revenue-generation and margin-protection position, responsible for converting qualified bid opportunities into disciplined, competitive, and executable proposals.
responsibilities: 1. Bid Pipeline Development & Governance
The Estimator is accountable for managing a controlled and intentional bid pipeline sourced exclusively from two approved channels and governed by formal bid controls.
This includes accountability for:
Developing estimates from inbound bid invitations received directly from General Contractors (GCs)
Managing negotiated and relationship-based bid opportunities
Proactively identifying bid opportunities through approved sourcing platforms (e.g., PlanHub, AGC sites, public bid portals)
Screening all opportunities using documented bid/no-bid criteria
Enforcing capacity, backlog, and risk constraints prior to pursuit
Managing bid calendars, deadlines, addenda, and final submission timing
Coordinating pursuit strategy and prioritization with the VP of Sales & Marketing
2. Estimating & Bid Development
The Estimator is accountable for producing complete, defensible, and market-aligned estimates.
Performing detailed quantity takeoffs for all commercial plumbing systems
Developing labor projections using standardized productivity assumptions
Pricing materials, fixtures, equipment, and subcontracted work using current supplier data
Accounting for escalation, phasing, access constraints, and schedule impacts
Identifying and documenting scope gaps, exclusions, clarifications, and assumptions
Preparing bid proposals, scope letters, and qualifications in approved formats
3. Pricing, Margin & Market Risk Management
The Estimator is accountable for protecting margin in dynamic market conditions.
Maintaining current price books, supplier data, and labor modifiers
Incorporating material volatility, labor availability, and escalation risk into estimates
Validating estimates against historical job cost and profitability data
Applying approved overhead, labor burden, and profit targets
Escalating abnormal market conditions to Sales leadership
4. Sales Alignment & Pre-Bid Support
The Estimator is accountable for collaborating in a disciplined manner with Sales leadership and external stakeholders.
Participating in bid/no-bid and pricing strategy discussions
Responding to GC inquiries, addenda, and clarification requests
Supporting value engineering efforts without compromising margin or scope
Ensuring all pre-award commitments are documented and approved
5. Project Handoff to Operations
The Estimator is accountable for a formal, standardized transition of awarded projects.
This includes accountability for delivering a complete handoff package consisting of:
Final estimate summary
Labor budgets and productivity assumptions
Material pricing assumptions and supplier commitments
Exclusions, clarifications, and scope qualifications
Documented risk items and constraints
qualifications: Experience
Minimum 8 years of commercial Plumbing or HVAC experience, including estimating
Demonstrated success in estimating complex commercial construction projects
Knowledge
Commercial Plumbing systems, HVAC systems, and construction means and methods
Job costing, labor productivity, and market pricing dynamics
Competitive, negotiated, and alternative delivery bid environments
Skills
High analytical rigor and attention to detail
Independent judgment under deadline pressure
Clear written and verbal communication
Ability to enforce discipline without positional authority

jobgether-jobgether:lever:33ef0e11-a96a-.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:33ef0e11-a96a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Belgium. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Requirements: Cybersecurity and threat intelligence interest: Suitable for aspiring CTI analysts, cybersecurity students or graduates, SOC professionals seeking CTI exposure, career changers, intelligence or security professionals transitioning into cyber, self-taught practitioners, and professionals with relevant cybersecurity certifications. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions. Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization. Source evaluation: Ability to assess the reliability

jobgether-jobgether:lever:477ed5e0-2bcf-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping.
